name: Button
intent: Triggers an action in the current view: submit a form, confirm a dialog, start a task. Combine with Card actions, Dialog actions and form layouts. For navigation to another page pass href so it renders a link.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. One solid button per view or group; outline for secondary actions; ghost for low-emphasis or repeated actions.

props.name: color
props.description: Intent. danger only for destructive, irreversible actions.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height. sm in dense UI (tables, toolbars), lg for a single hero action.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and blocks clicks while the action runs.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon after the label (e.g. an arrow for 'Next').

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to the container width. Use in narrow layouts and mobile forms.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders a link styled as a button. Use for navigation only.

props.name: sx
props.description: Layout-only overrides (margin, alignment). Never colors or sizes.

variants.name: solid
variants.intent: The most important action in a view or group.

variants.name: outline
variants.intent: Secondary actions next to a solid button (e.g. Cancel).

variants.name: ghost
variants.intent: Low-emphasis or repeated actions, e.g. in lists, toolbars, alerts.

sizes.name: sm
sizes.intent: Dense UI: tables, toolbars, inline with small text.

sizes.name: md
sizes.intent: Default for forms, cards and dialogs.

sizes.name: lg
sizes.intent: A single prominent call to action on a page.

when: The user performs an action that changes something (save, send, delete, create).

whenNot.situation: Navigating to another page as plain text in a sentence
Toggling a setting on and off
An icon with no visible label

composition: At most one solid primary Button per group of actions.
In a group, order is: ghost/outline actions first, the solid action last (right).
Destructive confirmation: color="danger" variant="solid", paired with an outline Cancel.
Labels are verbs that say what happens: "Save changes", not "OK".

accessibility.role: button (or link when href is set)
notes: The label must describe the action; icon-only buttons need aria-label.
While loading the button is disabled; announce the result elsewhere (e.g. an Alert).
